Our network of 450 venues worldwide, hosting 20,000 events and entertaining 165 million guests each year, is powered by our depth of expertise and level of execution across every component feasibility & consulting, owner’s representation, sales, partnerships, hospitality, merchandise, venue management, and content & booking of world-class live events and venues.

Position Summary:

The Pensacola Bay Center Administrative Internship Program offers students the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the fast-paced world of live entertainment, sports, and venue management. Interns will work directly with different departments such as, but not limited to Events Services, Food and Beverage, Box Office, and other departments related to the functionality of the Pensacola Bay Center. This internship provides a unique behind-the-scenes look at the operations of a multi-purpose arena while developing professional skills in event management, food service, guest experience, and more vital professional skills in the hospitality industry.

- Assist with content creation for social media platforms

- Create and support digital marketing campaigns and distribute promotional materials

- Conduct market research studies to identify target audiences

- Assist with event planning processes and event execution

- Coordinate with clients and sponsors to manage their needs

- Provide recaps of marketing campaigns and post-show event information

- Assist with scheduling staff across catering, concessions, nonprofit groups, and bartenders

- Support ordering and warehouse operations including liquor, beer, non-alcoholic beverages, dry goods, and produce

- Help maintain inventory levels through stocking, counting, and organization

- Support during live events to ensure smooth execution in concessions and catering roles

- Assist with daily box office operations, including ticketing and customer service

- Aid in resolving ticketing issues, customer inquiries, and box office reporting

- Support during event days by assisting with box office window, will call, and ticketing concerns

- Support event setup through diagrams, equipment orders, and additional information

- Assist in monitoring venue readiness, cleanliness, and safety

- Attend and participate in internal meetings, including production, food & beverage, and hockey operations

- Other duties as assigned

- Currently enrolled or recently graduated from a college or university

- Pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (i.e. business, hospitality, marketing, or related field)

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment

- Maintain a professional presentation, appearance, and work ethic

- Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Canva and Adobe.

- Availability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays (as required for events)

- Subject to credit and background screening

Location: Onsite at Pensacola Bay Center, Pensacola, FL

About the company

General Matter enriches uranium.

We are designing, building, and operating the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services, here in the US.

In the process, we are restoring America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel to power AI, advanced manufacturing and critical industries our country relies on to remain competitive.

Fuel drives the cost of advanced reactor electricity production, and enrichment drives the cost of the fuel that advanced reactors consume. Reliable, low-cost enrichment is the catalyst for the nuclear Renaissance now under way.

Our mission is to make nuclear not only the cleanest and safest source of baseload power, but also the most affordable. We believe abundant nuclear energy will lead to a post-scarcity society.

We were incubated inside Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by over a dozen of the world's top venture capital firms.

Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production.

We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency.

Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable.

About This Role

As a General Matter Embedded Engineering Intern, you will help develop performant, safe, and high-quality software that directly controls our enrichment systems. You will support the development of code responsible for commanding actuators and processing high-speed signals in applications where safety and accuracy are exceedingly important. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including electrical engineers, software engineers, chemical engineers, manufacturing engineers, nuclear engineers, materials scientists, and physicists.

Responsibilities

- Assist in the development of safety-critical embedded software that powers General Matter's industrial systems with reliability and precision.

- Help build low-level firmware in C/C++, Rust, and/or PLCs to control electromechanical actuators, process high-speed sensor data, and execute fault-tolerant control logic.

- Support the design of control architectures, state machines, and data acquisition systems for mission-critical hardware.

- Contribute to automated build, test, and validation infrastructure for embedded software.

- Partner closely with hardware, electrical, and controls engineers to bring up new systems, integrate firmware with hardware, and troubleshoot electromechanical challenges.

- Assist with debugging real-world embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and other laboratory instrumentation.

- Support integrated system testing and commissioning of embedded software running on production equipment.

Basic Qualifications

- Current undergraduate or graduate student pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a similar discipline.

- Development experience in C, C++, Golang, Python, or Rust.

- General understanding of embedded or low-level systems development.

- Collaborative team member who thrives in fast-paced, multidisciplinary environments and is eager to learn.

- Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Exposure to data acquisition system setup, maintenance, or development.

- Familiarity with electrical hardware troubleshooting or PCBA bring-up.

- Coursework or project experience in digital signal processing.

- Exposure to low-level communication protocol debugging.

- Coursework or project experience with PLC/SCADA systems.

- Experience in a fast-paced engineering environment or project setting requiring a resourceful, entrepreneurial approach to complete tasks within tight timeframes.

Additional Requirements

- Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary.

Equal Opportunity Employer

General Matter is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with General Matter is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Compensation and Benefits

The hourly pay range for this internship is $32–$46 per hour, depending on the candidate's current standing in school (i.e. sophomore, senior).

Interns will receive a monthly housing stipend, and are eligible for overtime pay. Please note that the stated hourly range is an estimate and may be adjusted based on market conditions, business needs, or other factors.

Program Overview:

Verisk's 2027 Summer Internship Program is designed to provide you with meaningful real-world experience, professional development, and networking opportunities. Recognized as a Top 100 Internship Program by Yello and WayUp, our program empowers interns to make a tangible impact while learning from industry experts and building connections across the organization.

This is a full-time (40 hours/week), paid internship program spanning ten weeks from June through August 2027. Participation in the program requires that you are located near your assigned office, as our hybrid work schedule requires interns to work in the office at least 3 days per week throughout the summer.

Should you be invited back after your internship, you will have the opportunity to join a premier full-time program, the AI Excellence Program. This program combines real business impact from day one with a 12-month structured journey to accelerate AI capabilities. This is not a traditional entry-level program—it’s a launchpad for careers in AI-powered innovation, where you will collaborate across functions, influence real decisions, and accelerate your growth in a global organization.

As an AI Intern, you will work at the intersection of business, technology, and data, applying AI to solve enterprise-wide challenges and drive measurable impact.

We are hiring in the following U.S. locations:

- Jersey City, NJ

Application deadline: Friday, Oct 2 @ 11:59pm ET

Required Submission Materials

- Updated Resume

- Cover Letter: Please respond to the following prompt:

"Tell us why you are interested in joining the Verisk Summer Internship Program and what excites you about the opportunity to potentially advance into Verisk's AI Excellence Program in the future. We encourage you to share how your experiences, interests, and career goals align with this opportunity."

Recruitment Process:

We want to get to know YOU. Once you apply, our team will review your application. Successful candidates will be invited to a two-stage interview process including:

- AI Project Portfolio: Should your resume get selected, you will be asked to submit a ZIP file containing examples of projects, coursework, research, or other work where you leveraged artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, or related technologies. The zip file should be saved as “first initial.last name_AI portfolio” (ex: a.smith_AI portfolio).

- Digital Interview: Our team is keen to get to know you. You'll be introduced to several members of our team as they share their experiences about life at Verisk. We will ask you a series of questions in order to learn about what drives you and your career interests and aspirations – this is your opportunity to make yourself stand out from the pack. This is also a great way for you to meet several of our employees outside of a traditional 1:1 interview.

- Recruiter Screening Call: During this round, you’ll connect with a member of our campus recruiting team for a brief conversation. We’ll review your background, discuss your interests and goals, and share more about the Summer Internship Program. This is also a great opportunity for you to ask questions and learn more about what it’s like to start your career at Verisk.

- Final Live Virtual Interview: This round is to determine if Verisk’s culture is right for you. You'll have the opportunity to speak with several members of our actuarial recruitment committee.

- Offer: Our committee will meet and discuss your candidacy. Should you be extended an offer, we will advise you of the business and location where your internship will take place.

Responsibilities

What You Could Learn:

- Use AI and data-driven insights to solve real business challenges that impact customers, operations, and strategy across the enterprise.

- Develop cutting-edge AI skills while learning how leading organizations use technology to solve complex business problems.

- Collaborate with teams across technology, product, analytics, HR, and finance in AI Labs where you work to automate processes and solve business problems

- You'll have opportunities to experiment with emerging AI technologies, build future-ready skills, and learn from experts across the organization.

- Help shape how AI transforms the future of work while solving challenges that improve how employees and customers experience our business

- Complete learning and development sessions, attend networking events, and showcase successes with leadership at key events.

Qualifications

What we’re looking for

- Enrolled in a bachelors or masters program.

- Must be graduating in December 2027 or May/June 2028.

- Must be available to begin the internship program on June 2, 2027, and participate in the full 10-week program.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or Claude in everyday work, projects, or learning

- Experience using AI beyond basic prompting (e.g., workflows, automations, or applied use cases)

- Exposure to tools like Excel, Power BI, Tableau or similar

- Prior experience utilizing data, technology, or AI to solve a problem

- Ability to use AI to support problem-solving, decision-making, and process improvement

- Comfort working with data. This includes analyzing information, spotting trends, and building simple dashboards or reports

- Excellent communication and time management skills

- Ability to collaborate across teams and adapt in a fast-paced environment

- Proactive, self-driven mindset with a willingness to experiment and continuously learn

Build Smarter Ways of Working

At Cerro Flow Products, a Marmon Holdings company backed by Berkshire Hathaway, we’re exploring how artificial intelligence and emerging technologies can improve the way we work across our manufacturing operation.

We’re looking for curious, creative, and technology-minded interns who are excited to learn, experiment, and help turn ideas into practical solutions. This opportunity is ideal for students or recent graduates interested in artificial intelligence, data analytics, technology, business process improvement, engineering, or related fields.

This is an onsite, part-time internship located at our Sauget, Illinois facility.

What You’ll Do

As an Artificial Intelligence Intern, you’ll work with employees and leaders across the organization to identify opportunities where AI and other digital tools may improve efficiency, communication, data analysis, and decision-making.

Because this is an emerging area within our organization, projects may evolve based on business needs, intern interests, and opportunities identified throughout the internship.

Responsibilities may include:

- Researching artificial intelligence tools, technologies, and potential business applications.
- Partnering with different departments to understand current processes, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
- Helping identify repetitive or time-consuming tasks that may benefit from automation or AI-assisted solutions.
- Supporting the development and testing of AI-based tools, workflows, prompts, or process improvements.
- Organizing, reviewing, and analyzing business or operational data.
- Assisting with the creation of dashboards, reports, summaries, or other decision-support resources.
- Comparing available technologies and presenting recommendations to business leaders.
- Documenting processes, project findings, testing results, and recommended next steps.
- Developing user guides, training materials, or presentations to help employees understand and use new tools.
- Supporting responsible AI practices, including data privacy, accuracy, confidentiality, and appropriate human review.
- Presenting completed projects and key learnings to leadership and other stakeholders.
- Contributing ideas and bringing a fresh perspective to how technology can support a manufacturing organization.

What You’ll Gain

This internship is designed to provide meaningful, hands-on learning experience and professional growth.

During the internship, you’ll have the opportunity to gain:

- Practical experience applying AI and emerging technologies in a real business environment.
- Exposure to manufacturing operations and a variety of business functions.
- Experience working on projects with measurable organizational impact.
- Opportunities to collaborate with employees and leaders across multiple departments.
- Experience evaluating tools, solving problems, and presenting recommendations.
- A stronger understanding of responsible and practical AI implementation.
- Professional mentorship, feedback, and opportunities to develop your technical and business skills.
- Insight into career paths involving artificial intelligence, technology, analytics, operations, and continuous improvement.
- Experience with a global organization backed by Berkshire Hathaway.

What We’re Looking For

- Current enrollment in or recent completion of a program related to artificial intelligence, computer science, data analytics, information systems, engineering, business, mathematics, or another related field.
- Interest in artificial intelligence, automation, data, and emerging technologies.
- Curiosity and a willingness to explore unfamiliar tools and business problems.
- Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to communicate technical ideas in a clear and practical way.
- Ability to work independently while also collaborating with employees from different departments.
